summary: BTC ~$80.2k (-1% 24h) after briefly breaking below $80k for the first time in over a month on reports of US military readiness against Iran; over $200m of leveraged longs liquidated within an hour. Macro-driven risk-off, not a crypto-specific failure. Down from -0.05.
catalyst_note: Weekend selloff tied to US-Iran tensions and US diplomat withdrawals from the Middle East (25 Oct 2026, X news summary)
